author: bardic-inspiration
name: Cat Burglar
summary: A rooftop thief who opens locks, scales walls, and strikes from behind with a hidden blade.
description: They take what is out of reach, and the guards learn about it the next morning. A cat burglar who is cornered is rarely there for long: the nearest window is usually already open.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: Once per turn, the burglar deals an extra {dmg:2d6:piercing} damage to a creature it hits with an attack roll if the roll had {ref:glossary/advantage}, or if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it and doesn't have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The burglar makes two Rapier attacks.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.text: The burglar takes the {ref:glossary/dash}, {ref:glossary/disengage}, or {ref:glossary/hide} action.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.text: *Trigger:* An attacker the burglar can see hits it with an attack roll. *Response:* The burglar halves the attack's damage against it.
